summary: Reviewed all modified source files: _shared.yaml, 1-planner.yaml, 2-project-manager.yaml, scripts/build-personas.js, and sampled generated output (VS Code + Claude Code, agents 1, 3, 5). All 9 acceptance criteria confirmed met.

Model resolution chain in buildForTarget() (lines 551-557) is architecturally correct and follows the established version-resolution pattern immediately above it. Using !== undefined is the precise check for optional YAML fields. Fallback chain (per-persona → default_model → cc_model → 'inherit') is logically sound and backward-compatible.

Context object composition pattern (shared fields → ...persona spread → explicit computed overrides) is the standard JavaScript override idiom. The final cc_model: ccModel placement after the spread correctly ensures the pre-computed value always wins regardless of what persona YAML contains.

One low-priority dead-code observation: the initial cc_model: sharedMeta.cc_model assignment in the context object (line ~604) is always superseded by cc_model: ccModel after the spread. It adds noise but causes no functional defect. Non-blocking.

One low-priority forward-fragility observation: model: {{model}} in FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_VSCODE is unquoted. Current model names are YAML-safe; 'Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6' contain no YAML special characters. However this pattern is inherited from the pre-existing cc_model handling in FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC and is consistent throughout all frontmatter templates. Recommend quoting as a defensive measure in a future tidy-up pass. Non-blocking.
No blocking issues found. Implementation is clean, maintainable, and architecturally sound.

comments.note: scripts/build-personas.js context object (~line 604): `cc_model: sharedMeta.cc_model` is set as an initial property but is always overridden first by `...persona` spread and then by the explicit `cc_model: ccModel` assignment. The initial assignment is dead code. Removing it would make the intent of the three-step override pattern (shared defaults → persona override → computed final) immediately clear without requiring mental tracking of duplicate keys.

FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_VSCODE (line 420): `model: {{model}}` is emitted unquoted. Current model strings ('Claude Opus 4.6', 'Claude Sonnet 4.6') are YAML-safe. This is consistent with the pre-existing unquoted `model: {{cc_model}}` in FRONTMATTER_LEDGER_CC and all other unquoted scalar fields (author, version, role, etc.). Non-blocking today, but recommend quoting as a future defensive hygiene pass: `model: '{{model}}'`. The same applies to `cc_model` in CC/standalone templates.

No further observations — implementation is clean, well-structured, and consistent with all established build-script conventions. The per-persona model override pattern mirrors the existing version override and will be easy for future maintainers to extend.
